user.title: Vimar Intercom
user.description:
Open the Vimar View app, go to Settings → System → Export configuration, and scan or copy the QR code it shows. Paste the whole payload below.

The payload is encrypted; Home Assistant decrypts it locally and stores the credentials in this config entry.

confirm.title: Confirm the panel

reconfigure.title: Update the QR code
reconfigure.description: Paste a fresh QR payload from the Vimar View app. The existing device identity is kept so the Vimar cloud still recognises this installation.

error.invalid_qr: That does not look like a Vimar QR payload. Copy the whole string, including any trailing '=' characters.

abort.already_configured: This intercom is already set up.
abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Vimar intercom can be set up.
abort.wrong_panel: That QR code belongs to a different panel. Remove the existing entry first.

init.title: Vimar Intercom options
init.description: Panel addresses are the SIP extensions of your entrance panels, comma separated. Add ':Name' to label one, for example '55001:Street Gate, 55002:Building Door'.

data.prefer_local: Prefer the panel on the local network

error.invalid_panels: Panel addresses must be numeric SIP extensions, comma separated.
error.invalid_door_command: The door open command must be letters, digits and underscores only, for example OPEN_2F. It is sent to the panel exactly as written.

registration_down.title: Vimar Intercom is not registered
registration_down.description: The intercom has not been registered with the Vimar cloud for more than five minutes, so the doorbell will not ring in Home Assistant. Home Assistant keeps retrying. Check that the panel is online and that this host can reach {proxy_host} on port {proxy_port}.

migration_required.title: Vimar Intercom must be set up again
migration_required.description: This Home Assistant was using Vimar Intercom 1.x, and version 2 cannot reuse its configuration: the credentials used to be edited into the integration's source and now come from the QR code the Vimar View app exports, which Home Assistant cannot fetch for you. The intercom will not work until you do this: go to Settings > Devices & services, delete the Vimar Intercom entry, then add the integration again and paste the QR payload from the Vimar View app (Settings > System > Export configuration). Most entity IDs change; see the integration's README before rewriting your automations.
